summary: Apply approved native manual address entry and block Android device location; retire the native geocoding endpoint without forwarding coordinates.
noAssistantImpact: Address entry remains form-only. No assistant tool or capability is added; no model can invoke the retired public native geocoding route. Existing business ownership, address persistence and country validation remain unchanged. The separate web lookup is outside this Android slice.

evidence.result: Valid legacy coordinates fail FORBIDDEN without provider/DB access; malformed coordinates fail BAD_REQUEST. Focused router/business-country suite passes 3 tests/11 assertions.
